purpose: The capability statement plus the 'Trusted By' logo marquee. Two stacked blocks inside one section: a vertically looping capability column, and a horizontally looping band of 11 third-party logos.

headingLead.note: Measured: 2 words, "AI that" - the sentence is completed by whichever capability is currently in the looping column.

capabilities.note: Exactly 3, measured 2 words each: Create Images, Makes videos, Stays on-brand. Duplicated into a second identical column so the vertical loop is seamless.

accessibleLabel.note: The source supplies NO text alternative for any of the 11 logos - they are bare inline SVG with no .u-hidden-copy sibling and no aria-label. This field exists so generated output can do better; it is an accessibility gap in the source, recorded not silently inherited.

trustedLogos.note: Exactly 11 distinct marks, each on a 104x24 viewBox, duplicated across two identical rows (22 inline occurrences).

evidence.structure: Structure, layout and motion measured against the live original. A pixel audit verified 1382/1382 elements at a 1440px viewport and 962/962 at 390px with zero deltas. Copy is the original's own.

constraints.verification: src/pages/Home.jsx:15 renders <How /> fourth. Checked against all 5 real templates: it appears only in `home`, immediately after showcase.ai-capabilities.

trustedLogos.warning: THE HIGHEST-RISK ASSETS IN THIS REPOSITORY. These are other companies' real trademarks placed in a 'Trusted By' slot. Never reproduce, redraw, approximate or invent them, and never imply an endorsement.

motion.detail: Two CSS marquees, both 24s linear infinite: .how__column runs the columnanima keyframe (translateY 0 -> -100%) and .how__bottom-row runs the marquee keyframe (translateX 0 -> -100%). The capability heading also carries data-flash via .how__left-title. Both ends of the logo band are masked by .how__bottom-gr-left / -gr-right.
motion.reducedMotionFallback: Freeze both marquees at their first frame, showing the first capability and the first visible run of logos, and render the heading unsplit at text.primary.
motion.reducedMotionFallbackKind: design-rule (the source ships NO prefers-reduced-motion handling for this section, so the fallback is prescribed by this repository, not mirrored)

responsive.base: eyebrow + heading + CTA on the left, the looping capability column on the right; the logo band spans the full width below
responsive.max-767px: heading.display drops to 2.25rem and label.tag to 1rem

contentMaxWordsTotalNote: Set BETWEEN the measured real total and the maximum the per-field budgets allow, so the cap can actually reject an over-long instance instead of being unreachable. extraction/verify_all.py check [p] fails if any declared contentMaxWordsTotal becomes vacuous (>= the per-field maximum). Previously 60, which was unreachable.
